primary_source.title: Parametrization of the box variety by theta functions
locators: Section 3 cusp branch parametrization alpha(tau)=tau*(a1,a2)+(Phi1(Q),Phi2(Q)), Q=exp(2*pi*i*tau), with a1,a2 positive multiples of 4 and a1+a2 divisible by 8

local_adapter.derivation: u composed with alpha is Q^(a1/4) times a holomorphic unit; v composed with alpha is Q^(a2/4) times a holomorphic unit
local_adapter.parity: e_z+e_w is even, hence e_z and e_w have the same parity; therefore m is odd iff both modular local degrees are odd
local_adapter.first_projection_extremal_consequence: because the normalized quadratic base change is etale over C0 in the first projection, every first-factor cusp local degree is 1 or 2; at an exceptional contact this forces e_z=m, so m1 gives e_z=1 and m2 gives e_z=2
local_adapter.second_projection_contact_form: at every exceptional contact e_w=m+2*r with integer r>=0

coarse_node_split.equations: for each exceptional node total m_j, write m_j=x_j+2*y_j where x_j counts m1 branches and y_j counts m2 branches
coarse_node_split.firewall: this is only an integer branch-splitting witness; it does not realize analytic branches or the exact node-to-cusp incidence

first_factor.rigid_nonexceptional_cusp_points: exactly C.L points of local degree 2 over each cusp, hence 182 in total
first_factor.exceptional_local_degrees: 210 m1 contacts give e_z=1; 28 m2 contacts give e_z=2
first_factor.per_cusp_if_y_L_m2_contacts: a_L=M_L-2*y_L and b_L=C.L+y_L, giving cycle type 1^a_L 2^b_L and a_L+2*b_L=105

second_factor.exceptional_local_degree_form: e_w=m+2*r; all 210 odd cusp cycles are exactly the m1 exceptional contacts; no nonexceptional odd cusp preimage is allowed because Y->N has only those 210 branch points

effect_on_previous_scratch_witnesses.reason: both symmetric witnesses use 35 odd cusp cycles at every cusp, while the exact carrier exceptional mass ledger contains a cusp of mass 25, so that cusp can support at most 25 m1/odd exceptional contacts
effect_on_previous_scratch_witnesses.scope: this rejects only those explicit symmetric scratch witnesses, not the full abstract monodromy populations

diagnostic_verdict.next_exact_route: replay the exact 48-node ordered cusp-pair incidence and test whether a nodewise y_j allocation together with carrier-attached first/second branch-cycle tuples and the common H4 torsor has any simultaneous realization
